title: Clippy pedantic hits about duplication and indirection
body:
From `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -W clippy::pedantic -W clippy::nursery`, keeping only the hits about duplication and indirection. Line numbers are at the commit this issue was created on.

| lint | sites |
|---|---|
| redundant clone | `channel.rs` 229 (two), 239 (two) |
| `clone_from` candidate | `channel.rs` 252, `compositor.rs` 3802, `save.rs` 319 to 321, `workspace.rs` 147 |
| argument taken by value and not consumed | `decade-channel/src/lib.rs` 185, 198; `channel.rs` 221 (`hello` takes `Value`), 261; `compositor.rs` 302, 1831, 2561, 2965; `mcp.rs` 198; `viewer.rs` 833; `viewer/clipboard.rs` 85; `workspace.rs` 50 |
| `&mut` taken and never mutated | `compositor.rs` 1475, 2143, 2166; `viewer.rs` 680; `viewer/clipboard.rs` 214 |
| identical match arms | `compositor.rs` 3539, `script.rs` 309, `viewer.rs` 579 |
| single-pattern `match` that is an `if let` | `compositor.rs` 1544, 3787 |
| `map_or` candidate | `compositor.rs` 1499, 1757, 2627; `control.rs` 89; `viewer/clipboard.rs` 278; `panes.rs` 529, 551 |
| redundant closure | `compositor.rs` 2003, 2602, 2886; `settings.rs` 127; `wire.rs` 1518 |
| `filter_map(..).next()` is `find_map` | `gpu.rs` 28 |
| `async fn` with no await | `mcp.rs` 238 (`list_tools`) |
| `Arc::default()` and `XkbConfig::default()` | `mcp.rs` 68, `compositor.rs` 396 |
| `Eq` derivable | `decade-channel/src/lib.rs` 41, 56, 63 |
| `unused_self` | `panes.rs` 344 (`client_rect`) |

Dropped as style: about 163 `use_self`, about 300 cast lints, `long_literal_lacking_separators`, and the `()` match arms.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/913b1d2c
notes.text:
Re-ran `cargo clippy -- -W clippy::pedantic -W clippy::nursery` at 3e2fe5c plus this phase's commits. Fixed in 3347d46: the redundant clones in `channel.rs` and `workspace.rs`, `filter_map(..).next()` in `gpu.rs`, and six methods that took `&mut self` without changing anything.

Left as they are:

- `needless_pass_by_value`: `Launch`, `Drag`, `wire::Scroll`, `wl_pointer::Event` and the like are messages moved into their handler. `OwnedFd` in `Offer::receive` is closed when the call returns, which is intended. `read_lines` in `decade-channel` owns its stream on its own thread.
- `derive_partial_eq_without_eq` on `decade-channel`'s public types: adding `Eq` changes the library's API, so it would need a changelog entry. It removes no duplication.
- `assigning_clones` (`clone_from`), `map_or`, `single_match_else`, redundant closures over a method, `match_same_arms` on the `{}` arms in `viewer.rs`, the test `for_each` calls: style only.
- `unused_async` on `list_tools`: it implements a trait method, which must be `async`.
